mods.name: Multiplayer
mods.author: Nattdy
mods.description: Online and LAN multiplayer for up to 16 players: discovery-server browser plus LAN discovery, dedicated server support, owner-authoritative car sync (each machine drives its own car and broadcasts its state; peers adopt it verbatim), a player-chosen on-foot character from the JMPPED archive (Tanner, Jericho and custom entries) synced through the host, in-match chat, a host-maintained roster, and a generic JERICHO addon net bridge. Minor version tracks MP_PROTO_VERSION (21).

mods.name: Car Hacks
mods.author: Nattdy
mods.description: Vehicle-availability and cross-city vehicle hacks for Driver 2: unlock the extra vehicles in the frontend car list, and import vehicles that belong to another city's data. Standalone (lifted out of Caine's Crossfire) so it can be enabled next to the multiplayer module.

mods.name: CRUMPLE
mods.author: Nattdy + DeepSeek
mods.description: Impact-driven vertex deformation + wheel damage. The flagship JERICHO package: dents, crumples, bent wheels, surface-roughness amplification, and the Crumple Debug pause submenu.

mods.name: BAKE Toolkit
mods.author: Nattdy
mods.description: BAKE Toolkit 0.4.0: Driver 1 (1999) traffic car shapes for carhacks plus the JMPPED pedestrian archive suite for pedhacks, built from your own Driver 1 / Driver 2 data. See docs/DRIVER1.md and tools/ped/.

mods.name: FULL TWIST
mods.author: Nattdy
mods.description: Free-physics tumbles: cars keep their spin after a hit, scenery torque uses the convex hull contact, walls bounce, and car-car recoil is tamed.

mods.name: Yaris Bounce
mods.author: Nattdy
mods.description: The squishy-Yaris meme effect: squash & stretch the car body's vertex copy as it drives (RSIN phase + quartic ease), drawn without touching physics or collision.

mods.name: Hallgarth's Cars
mods.author: Hallgarth, Njurse; thanks Commando52Colton
mods.description: Hallgarth's Pontiac Firebird as a BAKE car bank (HALLCHCG): the updated Firebird model with its own paint pages, wheels and sounds. Clean, damaged and low LODs. Enable and play: carhacks registers the bank on its own (JERICHO 0.13.4+). Older games: add banks/hallchcg/cities.ini to JERICHO/CONFIG/cities.ini.

mods.name: Ant Farm Screensaver
mods.author: Nattdy
mods.description: Passive city observer / idle screensaver: tours the map with 17 cinematic camera angles while the city keeps living; stands down during multiplayer. Compiled-in module (source package; already built into the JERICHO executable).

mods.name: Chicago Big Rig
mods.author: Njurse, Commando52Colton
mods.description: The Chicago Big Rig as a BAKE car bank (BIGRIG): the full truck, cab-only and trailer-only variants, with clean, damaged and low LODs. Enable and play: carhacks registers the bank on its own (JERICHO 0.13.4+). Older games: add banks/bigrig/cities.ini to JERICHO/CONFIG/cities.ini.
